baseline: Current deployed repository inspected before implementation: config.js reports 1.13.3 / 1926, while several loaded modules still use older 1923 cache-buster labels.

root_causes.overnight_regions: The selected-trip solver ultimately gets candidate towns from state.catalog. The existing independent regional fallback used only Nominatim reverse-geocoding, with up to 24 seeds and concurrency 6. A transient/provider-throttling failure therefore starved both moving-roadtrip overnight selection and base-trip selection.
root_causes.smart_base: The base solver itself is deterministic, but it can only select a base and day trips from the same candidate pool. Sparse regional discovery therefore appears as 'geen geschikte centrale uitvalsbasis' even when real towns exist.
root_causes.poi: The final POI gap filler was Overpass-only. When public Overpass mirrors were slow/empty, missing restaurant/fuel/rest/activity items remained unresolved.
root_causes.accommodation: Accommodation already had multiple providers but successful results were not persistently reused across future plans, causing repeated external searches.
root_causes.proposal_images: Image metadata was cached by proposal id, but dynamically rediscovered proposals can receive different ids. Cross-origin image bytes were also outside the service worker cache.
root_causes.dashboard_slogan: The dashboard hero still used the generic question slogan instead of a distinct ReisSlim brand line.

changes.destination_discovery: Photon reverse geocoding is now the fast primary source; two Overpass mirrors are a secondary batch source; Nominatim is a deliberately rate-limited tertiary fallback. Results are cached for 30 days and stale-cache fallback is allowed for 180 days.
changes.regional_supply: Regional overnight/base discovery now uses dense route-corridor + anchor rings, Photon primary, batched Overpass secondary, rate-limited Nominatim tertiary, fresh and stale caches, and returns up to 24 real named locality profiles. Base and moving modes use different seed geometry.
changes.poi: Missing POIs now use Overpass, then Photon, then a targeted external map-search link rather than silently disappearing. Successful POIs are cached for 14 days with 90-day stale fallback.
changes.accommodation: Specific accommodation selections are cached for 21 days with 120-day stale fallback. Overpass + Photon + a limited Nominatim fallback remain available; generic map links are not cached as if they were verified accommodation.
changes.images: Proposal image metadata is keyed by normalized destination name/country rather than transient proposal id. Actual Wikimedia/external image responses are cached in Cache Storage and by the service worker, while map tiles are deliberately excluded.
changes.dashboard: Hero becomes 'Ga ver. ReisSlim.' with eyebrow 'Minder zoeken. Meer roadtrip.'
changes.pending_images: The deployed 4-second guard pacing is returned to 1 second.
